D/ [IMP C VICT]ORINVS P F AVG ; R/ [PAX AV]G

An incomplete copper alloy radiate of Victorinus (AD 269-271), reverse type Pax, draped, standing left, holding olive-branch in right hand and sceptre in left hand - PAS AVG. Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Victorinus, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C VICT]ORINVS P F AVG.
